nodes.label: Monte Carlo Simulation Demo
nodes.description: Monte Carlo simulation chart showing 200 simulations x 100 trades with WR=50% and R:R 1:2. Displays multiple equity curve paths (blue lines) diverging from starting equity of 1.0, growing upward over 100 trades. Title in Russian: 'Монте-Карло: 200 симуляций × 100 сделок (WR=50%, R:R 1:2)'. X-axis: Сделка (Trade number 0-100), Y-axis: Equity (multiplier 1.0-2.2+). Legend shows 'Начало' (Start) as a dashed line at equity=1.0.

nodes.label: Equity Curve Visualization
nodes.description: Fan of equity curves showing probability distribution of outcomes across 200 simulated trading paths, all starting at 1.0 and spreading upward over 100 trades.

nodes.label: 50% Win Rate Scenario
nodes.description: Simulation parameters: WR=50% (win rate), R:R=1:2 (risk-to-reward ratio), showing that positive expectancy leads to overall upward equity despite 50% win rate.
